message: Field "User.legacyId" is marked @ignore, but @unique on field "User.legacyId" uses it. Remove @ignore from "User.legacyId", which adds it to the Prisma 6 client, or remove @unique on field "User.legacyId", which makes Prisma 6 `db push` drop the index.
